use: Adult self-report, clinically supported screening or symptom measurement; not standalone diagnosis
rights: Explicit public-domain declaration; no noncommercial-only restriction in cited official declaration. Commercial electronic reproduction is an inference from public-domain status, not endorsement of HH.

missingness.recommended_conservative_implementation: null is unanswered, never zero; require complete applicable inputs; no imputation/prorating. Incomplete result is unavailable, not a negative screen. This is product handling, not a claimed validated manual missingness rule.

exposure_intro: Sometimes things happen to people that are unusually or especially frightening, horrible, or traumatic. For example:
exposure_examples: a physical or sexual assault or abuse
seeing someone be killed or seriously injured
having a loved one die through homicide or suicide.

gate.text: Have you ever experienced this kind of event?
gate.no: screen total = 0; stop; five symptom questions structurally skipped, not recorded as five NO answers
gate.missing: unavailable; do not treat as NO

stem: In the past month, have you...

items.text: had nightmares about the event(s) or thought about the event(s) when you did not want to?
tried hard not to think about the event(s) or went out of your way to avoid situations that reminded you of the event(s)?
been constantly on guard, watchful, or easily startled?
felt numb or detached from people, activities, or your surroundings?
felt guilty or unable to stop blaming yourself or others for the event(s) or any problems the event(s) may have caused?

total.operation: count YES among five symptoms if exposure YES; 0 if exposure NO

thresholds: VA primary-care research: 4 balanced false positives/negatives overall and men; missed more women. No universal HH threshold selected.
remaining: Branching/gate support and structural skip representation verified
